violation_type.title: Activities for Toddlers - Provide Large Muscle Development (26 TAC §746.2507(4))
violation_type.short_title: Activities for Toddlers - Provide Large Muscle Development
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined during the investigation that the victim was playing on equipment that is not age appropriate for a twenty-three-month-old. The playground equipment was designed for older children and presented an injury risk to the victim.

finding_variants.text: It was determined during the investigation that the victim was playing on equipment that is not age appropriate for a twenty-three-month-old. The playground equipment was designed for older children and presented an injury risk to the victim.
Outdoor area observed, no age appropriate play equipment for children to help build their large muscle groups observed.
Children ages 18-24 months and 2 years old were observed crawling under a play structure designed for ages 3 and up.
